metadata.description: Job-function plugins: reusable roles for agent teams, each in its own repository and versioned on its own.

plugins.name: engineering-practices
plugins.description: Shared working practices for every role: project onboarding, git with Conventional Commits, work packages, talking to other agents, and asset and code provenance.

plugins.name: game-designer
plugins.description: Game designer: documents how a game plays, designs levels and progression, balances difficulty with simulation, and sets feel targets.

plugins.name: gameplay-programmer
plugins.description: Gameplay programmer: implements game rules and systems as deterministic, tested code with a clean boundary to the engine.

plugins.name: graphics-programmer
plugins.description: Graphics programmer: builds what the player sees in real time: scenes, camera, lighting, animation driven by game events, input, and rendering performance.

plugins.name: technical-artist
plugins.description: Technical artist: creates original 3D models, materials, textures and shaders, preferably by script, and runs the asset pipeline into the engine.

plugins.name: sound-designer
plugins.description: Sound designer: creates original sound effects, music and ambience, and integrates them through a cue system with clean mixing.

plugins.name: ui-developer
plugins.description: UI developer: builds menus, HUDs and screens that bind to game state, with clean navigation, localisation and accessibility.

plugins.name: devops-engineer
plugins.description: DevOps engineer: CI pipelines, cross-platform builds, releases from Conventional Commits, store submissions, and open-source license compliance and credits.

plugins.name: frontend-web-developer
plugins.description: Front-end web developer: builds fast, accessible static websites, such as a product's landing and download site, with platform detection, store links and credits.

plugins.name: graphic-designer
plugins.description: Graphic designer: owns visual identity and 2D design: logo, colour and type, app icons, store and marketing art, UI visual design and website visuals.

plugins.name: code-reviewer
plugins.description: Code reviewer: reviews pull requests for design, correctness, tests, security, performance and readability, with labelled comments and a clear verdict.
